SELECT add_provenance('lineitem');
SELECT set_prob(provenance(), prob) FROM lineitem;
CREATE VIEW q6 AS SELECT DISTINCT 1 AS c1 FROM lineitem t0 WHERE t0.c9 >= 19940101 AND t0.c9 < 19950101 AND t0.c6 >= 5 AND t0.c6 <= 7 AND t0.c5 < 24;
